dict.string: Edith controls playback and opens terminal sessions in the app you select.
Edith shows a notch alert when a Bluetooth device connects or disconnects.
Edith shows your upcoming calendar events in the app.
Edith frames your camera for Edith Camera, the virtual camera video apps can pick, and shows a preview in the notch so you can check yourself before a call.
Edith connects to the machines, databases, and Companion servers you select on your local network.
Edith records voice memories in the Companion capture screen.
Edith needs this to scan an external drive you pick in the Cleaner.
Edith transcribes voice memories and speech in your videos into editable captions on this Mac.
